g.text: Head trained on the labels, offline (out-of-fold, 3 seeds)
Offline: first five SFT proposals per state, held-out rollouts 4–8 (labels used rollouts 1–3; Oracle = best action on rollouts 1–3); one SFT sample = 38.8%. Live: one SFT sample = 41.4%.
Bars: 95% intervals, task-clustered bootstrap (offline) or paired over tasks (live). Offline and live use different tasks: compare orderings, not sizes.
